title: Le Creuset Mini Cast Iron Cocotte – Red – With Lid
description:
Beautiful small Le Creuset enameled cast iron cocotte in the iconic red color, perfect for individual portions, sauces, desserts, or stylish table serving. This compact piece features a vibrant red exterior with a black interior and comes with its original matching lid.
Made from enameled cast iron, it ensures excellent heat retention and even cooking. It measures approximately 10 cm in diameter and about 7–8 cm in height.
In good vintage condition, with visible signs of use on the exterior edges and lid (see photos), consistent with age. The interior remains clean and fully functional.
A lovely and practical piece for everyday cooking, serving, or adding to a Le Creuset collection.
